what: The routes the Planner still read > 20% short on ANY leg (time to summit, descent or car to car) against >= 2 online reports after the 27-row repair, plus The Perfect Crime (its descent is shared with Easy Getaway). Most stored no times at all, so the walk model set them.
rule: As in audits/2026-10-08-route-timing-repairs.json: a published figure wins (inside a range, the reports' median clamped into it); else >= 3 timed reports or 2 that agree; a leg counts when its two ends match.

A row with no stored legs gets a FULL set or none: a stored summit leg beside a missing approach makes the Planner walk the whole gain AND add the leg on top (lib/planTimes.js). Where only the car-to-car time clears the bar, only totalHrs is stored: the whole-day shape 32 rows already use, which shows one car-to-car time and gives no alpine start rather than a split it cannot support.
A stored leg the evidence shows wrong but cannot replace is cleared, not guessed (Baker's 2 hr descent).
No 0-hour approach is written: no alpine row in the catalog uses one.

measured.note: lib/planTimes.js at the calculator defaults vs the first-pass online medians, 515 sampled routes. short = model < 0.8x online. Whole-day rows have no modelled time to summit or descent, so they leave those two counts (Baring, Pyramid Peak, Big Snagtooth).
measured.alpine: time to summit within 58% -> 62%; descent short 7 -> 5 of 32
